preview: This episode is about digital tip screens and the choices they ask customers to make. It looks at evidence from taxi payments and at the social pressure that can come with tipping on a screen. The story helps us see why the design of a simple payment question matters. By the end, you will understand what these screens can mean for customer decisions.
comment_1: Listen for what the tip screen may do before you decide how much the service was worth.
comment_2: A suggested number can shape a tip choice by setting the starting point in the customer’s mind. But what happens when that number feels too high?
comment_3: This story shows that a tip screen can shape a customer’s choice. It also raises bigger questions about how these screens affect customers. Let’s look at those questions now.
comment_4: So choosing a tip on a digital screen is no longer just a private choice, and customers are beginning to question the pressure they feel. Now let’s bring these points together and hear the main message.
